onboarding.step1Desc: Click the 'Open PDF' button or drag and drop any PDF file onto the app. All processing happens locally — your document never leaves your device.
onboarding.step2Desc: Click and drag on the page canvas to create a crop rectangle. Then adjust it using the 8 handles, or use presets from the properties panel.
onboarding.step3Desc: Select multiple pages in the sidebar using Ctrl/Cmd+Click, then press Ctrl+Enter to apply the current crop to all selected pages at once.
onboarding.step4Desc: Click 'Preview' to see exactly how the exported PDF will look, using the same rendering pipeline as the final export.
onboarding.step5Desc: Choose the export scope (current page, selected pages, or all), pick a mode (Crop box for speed, Redraw for true resizing), and click Export.
